# Release Notes

## 0.39.1 — 2026-10-18

- Production release `0.39.1` is active on exact SHA `d35b77094cf621c29cff3976d81aa2db3831ae7c` (PR `#37`, validation `39079490801`, approved production run `39079927016`; authoritative activation `2026-10-17T23:45:08.798620+00:00` / `2026-10-18T02:45:08.798620+03:00`). This PATCH preserves manual receipt review across crop/layout disagreement and invalidates durable decisions with cache version 5. Bot/API source hashes and effective active/non-shadow flags match the candidate; eight services are healthy, application restart counts are zero, public root/PWA return 200 and post-activation application/proxy logs are clean. **ARTIFACT DEPLOYED; DELIVERY INCOMPLETE:** the original unavailable error has no proven causal RED-to-GREEN or authenticated real-receipt upload/provider/review acceptance. Owner was asked to retry the same receipt and stop before financial confirmation. No financial/card/payment/consent action was performed. See `code/docs/releases/0.39.1-receipt-manual-review.md`.
- Exact source head before protected-main squash: `d1eebd817094ae941a41e480064a1504d91e8c1b`; identical Git tree to deployed `d35b77094cf621c29cff3976d81aa2db3831ae7c`. Independent code-safety review passed; focused suite: 39 passed / 54 subtests. These checks do not prove original incident resolution.
- Encrypted off-host backup verified before deployment: artifact `12118458167`; deployment evidence artifact `12118846078`. Server marker activation differs from the workflow evidence completion timestamp `2026-10-17T23:45:51.860868+00:00`.
- No controllable existing authenticated emulator session was found: ADB empty and probed CDP endpoints refused connections; no replacement emulator/container was created for acceptance. Production serving containers were recreated only by the approved canonical deployment.
